reviews.title: Great Value for the Price
reviews.comment: I think these are really good for the price and less hassle of cords these are a great option if you don't like cords hanging everywhere, they look amazing and have great quality. super easy to install and the rgb is perfect
reviews.author: Najae Williams

reviews.title: I will definitely be buying these again.
reviews.comment: Excellent product. The price is very good for the quality and the software was easy to install and use.
reviews.author: Tony

reviews.title: Beautiful fans but with some caveats.
reviews.comment: First off these are beautiful well made fans and are whisper quiet even at high speed. With that out of the way the only things keeping me from giving 5 stars are 1: they should provide more than one cable in the box for when you need split the set between a 240mm radiator and a single rear exhaust. 2: the implementation for the wireless controller is not pretty and I feel that rather have a larger usb dongle that you then run a wire back into the case to plug into a usb2 header and fan headers we could have something along the way of WiFi card.
reviews.author: Kyle Spicer

reviews.title: Make sure you buy the right blade
reviews.comment: These fans(regular blade) blow air out the backside(side without the logo) For some reason I though regular blade fans would do the opposite of that, make sure you double check that before buying. They still look great and work great. People have complained about the software before, and it has to be a skill issue. It took me maybe 5 minutes to set-up rpm-curves and rgb.
reviews.author: Keith Jones
